annotation.title_clean: Artificial Intelligence (AI) guidance, best practice and standards
annotation.title_en: Artificial Intelligence (AI) guidance, best practice and standards
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Government Analysis Function (UK Office for National Statistics)
annotation.summary_en: UK Government Analysis Function web page collating approved AI guidance for civil servants, pointing to the Data and AI Ethics Framework, the AI Playbook, and an A–Z list of government AI resources. It contains no robotics or embodied AI content.
key_provisions_or_claims: Recommends starting with the Data and AI Ethics Framework and the AI Playbook for the UK Government.
AI Playbook sets out 10 principles for civil servants using AI.
Departmental ethics frameworks (e.g., MoJ) complement the government-wide framework.
Lists approved guidance including AI Opportunities Action Plan and Introduction to AI assurance.
Staff should always consult departmental guidance and digital/IT teams first.
